03 / Puneri at heart

आपला महाराष्ट्र

Maharashtra,
one plate at a time.

Born in Pune, fed by all of Maharashtra. From the Konkan coast to Vidarbha, every corner has its own plate, veg and non-veg. We’re inspired by all of it.

See what we serve ↓
  1. 01PuneGhar. Home turf.Misal pav, bakarwadi & mastani
  2. 02MumbaiVada pav & pav bhaji
  3. 03KolhapurTambda-pandhra rassa
  4. 04Konkan · MalvanFish curry & solkadhi
  5. 05Nagpur · VidarbhaSaoji, the spicy one
  6. 06KhandeshJalgaon bharit & shev bhaji

Maharashtra’s food culture is our inspiration. These regional dishes are not our menu. Photos: Kolhapuri misal pav by Ankushkr2020, vada pav by Rutvi Mistry, via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0).
